# `csharp_space_between_method_declaration_empty_parameter_list_parentheses`

Space inside an empty parameter list ().

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `false`

## Example

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Reset( )
    {
        Console.WriteLine("reset");
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Reset()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("reset");
    }
}
```
:::

::::
